TITLE: Global Sedimentary Thickness model 1
DESCRIPTION: GST-1 is a global sedimentary thickness model, on a 0.125° x 0.125° grid. It was created by suites of 3D free air gravity inversions that modified the sediment thickness model of Mooney et al. (2023), which is gridded at 1° x 1°.
SHORT_DESCRIPTION: GST-1 is a global sedimentary thickness model, on a 0.125° x 0.125° grid.
AUTHOR: Bird DE, Mooney WD
CITATION: Bird DE, Mooney WD (2026) GST-1: A high-resolution global sediment thickness model. Tectonophysics 929:231175. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tecto.2026.231175
